purpose: Closed, versioned predicate vocabulary for deterministic SAFOR transition guards. Arbitrary executable expressions are forbidden.

predicates.description: Every dependency of the subject work item is ACCEPTED.
At least one active unrevoked Control-State mandate covers the subject work item and every required capability.
All subject work-item input refs resolve to value-stream objects with a non-null artifactRef.
The subject work item contains a schema-complete execution.resourceAccess declaration with readSet, writeSet and exclusiveKeys arrays.
A resolved state/event field equals the provided literal value.
A resolved state/event field is a member of the provided literal set.
The event type equals the provided value.
The event sequence is exactly lastAppliedEventSequence + 1.
The event subject resolves to exactly one work item.
